Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E13, E14): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Selene (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 46 lines between E1 and E14
Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14
Corin (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 37 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 4: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight.
E13: Mara must light the lamp to guide in the ship carrying Corin's accusers.
E14: The truth about the night Corin drowned comes out on the quay.
CLIP: [On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
[Action: the figure in period dress draws a short blade from a boot.]
a figure in period dress: "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
[Sound: The crowd gasps.]
[Hard cut]
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "You were always too soft for this family."
[Sound: The crowd gasps.]
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the widow toward the figure in period dress.]
a figure in period dress: "Say her name again and you will regret it."
[On screen: Low angle on the figure in period dress framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
[On screen: Low angle on the figure in period dress framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress (off-screen): "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
[Sound: Thunder cracks over the harbour.]
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the the figure in period dress toward the figure in period dress.]
[Action: the figure in period dress kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
[On screen: Close-up on the the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
[On screen: Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
